name: keepwork-aichat-rust
description: Rust + Tauri 2 native desktop application for KeepWork 第二大脑 (AIChat Desktop)

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/build.mjs && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features dev-bins && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.make:mac: node scripts/bundle-mcp-rust.cjs --target universal-apple-darwin && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
scripts.make:win:x64: node scripts/bundle-mcp-rust.cjs --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.make:win:arm64: node scripts/bundle-mcp-rust.cjs --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc && tauri build --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.make:mcp-node:mac: node scripts/bundle-mcp-runtime.cjs --require --target universal-apple-darwin && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
scripts.make:mcp-node:win:x64: node scripts/bundle-mcp-runtime.cjs --require --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis
scripts.make:mcp-rust:mac: node scripts/bundle-mcp-rust.cjs --target universal-apple-darwin && tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
scripts.make:mcp-rust:mac:arm64: node scripts/bundle-mcp-rust.cjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
